title: Google News Scraper API - Articles, Full Text & Decoded Links
desc: Get news articles from Google News by keyword, topic or top stories in any country: title, publisher, date, real article URL (decoded from Google links) and optional full text. $4 per 1,000 articles; full text +$3 per 1,000. Failed queries free.

title: Workday Jobs Scraper - myworkdayjobs.com API with Salary
desc: Get all job postings from any Workday career site (myworkdayjobs.com): title, locations, exact post date, req ID, remote type, salary range, full description and apply URL. Filter by keyword, location or date; scrapes past the 2,000-job limit. $2.00 per 1,000 jobs; failed sites are free.

title: Shopify App & Theme Detector - Store Analyzer & Contacts
desc: Find what apps and theme a Shopify store uses, in bulk: installed apps, theme, product count, price range, top vendors, % on sale, collections, currency, country, myshopify domain, emails, phones and social links. One row per store analyzed. $8 per 1,000 stores; non-Shopify sites are free.

title: Applicant Tracking Jobs Scraper - Greenhouse, Lever & 6 More
desc: Get job postings from applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Personio, BambooHR): all jobs on a company career page in one schema with title, location, remote, salary, description, apply URL and dates. $3 per 1,000 jobs; failed companies free.
